topics.flagship-ru-ua: President Zelenskyy says the US has floated NATO membership for Ukraine, the first time the question has been linked to territorial concessions (14 outlets). Ukraine reportedly launched nearly 1,200 drones at Russian targets, among its largest aerial attacks of the war, as US-led talks consider European security. Zelensky welcomed bringing Europe into the talks. A single outlet reports leaked Russian records putting Russian casualties near 450,000, and another reports Ukraine saying Starshield restrictions still hamper its drone defenses.
topics.flagship-ir-il: An Israeli airstrike in Mawasi, southern Gaza, reportedly killed senior Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis (4 outlets). Pakistan and 16 other Muslim countries condemned an Israeli strike on Nasser hospital. On Iran, Trump is reportedly weighing holding off on new strikes unless Tehran or the Houthis provoke the US, while sending mixed signals about ending the war. A single outlet reports the US is expanding efforts to disrupt Iran's supply networks beyond the naval blockade, targeting land borders and the Caspian Sea.
topics.T15: Stories are sparse and mostly generic. They include preparedness commentary (EU 72-hour kit guidance, Himalayan and Philippine tsunami readiness) and a retrospective on 2021 B.C. floods. The only fresh event is a magnitude 4.5 earthquake in Khargone, Madhya Pradesh, with no casualties reported. Commentary on the Microsoft outage also appears.
topics.T01: A Myanmar military airstrike on a displaced persons camp in Rakhine state killed 12 people, according to witnesses and a rescue worker (3 outlets). One outlet says Sudan's army (SAF) has made gains against the RSF in Kordofan. Two outlets report the Trump administration floating a new military front in Cuba, where a fuel blockade is already in place. A single outlet reports Mexican officials fear pressure for direct US military action. The ASEAN summit opens in Manila with conflicts on the agenda.
topics.T02: Sudan's humanitarian crisis is worsening as international aid falls, with almost 34 million people in need and drone strikes impeding delivery (single outlet). A coalition of more than 50 UN countries and organizations, led by the UK, Qatar and Jordan, is urging Israel to allow winter shelter, fuel, water and health supplies into Gaza. Single-outlet reports also cover drought risk in Central America's Dry Corridor and 17,000 children diagnosed with pneumonia in Kano, Nigeria.
topics.T04: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reportedly killed 5,471 of 11,197 confirmed cases, described as the deadliest in its history. Attacks on medics, public mistrust and the lack of an approved vaccine are complicating the response (2 outlets). Several other items appear to be old or unrelated: the Bihar encephalitis piece, the 2023 WHO mpox emergency end, and 2021 Thailand quarantine rules. A Macau influenza immunity study is also included.
topics.T05: Stories are disparate and each comes from a single outlet. They include at least 10 reportedly killed in a Guinea crackdown on artisanal gold mining in Siguiri, and ASEAN's envoy saying the bloc is not easing its Myanmar approach ahead of the Manila summit. Others cover Turkey's espionage accusations against critics, a Hungarian anti-corruption probe of an Orbán-era minister, and expanded German spy agency powers. No clear coup-risk signal emerges.
topics.T06: Around 106,000 people took to the streets across France in the fifth consecutive Saturday of 'Act V' anti-government protests, with police using tear gas and charging crowds (3 outlets). Coverage cites soaring living costs and public-service concerns, and one report says over 4,900 protesters were detained. Another outlet flags a possible new wave over police legislation and economic issues. A zero-source item reports Spain's first general strike in 14 years ending in riots and looting, which is unverified.
topics.T07: A potential Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral meeting at APEC is being negotiated, with a nuclear arms treaty and the US war on Iran among priority topics (9 outlets). One outlet notes the leaders have differing agendas, with Trump seeking nuclear arms control, leaving the outcome uncertain.
topics.T08: Indian security agencies are investigating the Nov 11 attack that wounded three CRPF personnel in Kulgam, Kashmir, with over 500 questioned and 20 detained (3 outlets). They are focusing on a Lashkar-e-Taiba module and suspect LeT's Mohammed Lateef Bhat. Separately, a single outlet reports four people killed in a suspected militant ambush on NH-2 in Manipur's Ukhrul district. Other items include a Bataclan anniversary piece and a UAE official's warning on European radicalism.
topics.T10: Items are varied and each single-sourced. They include Germany's record €561 billion 2027 budget and rearmament debate, a UN Geneva conference on autonomous weapons, and a Chinese PLA drone that delivers painkiller darts to wounded soldiers. Others cover the Philippines seeking Indian help with military satellites and a reported US-Israel aid deal of about $16.5 billion that could extend payments to 2033.
topics.T11: India and Sri Lanka began the 12th Mitra Shakti exercise at Maduru Oya, running Nov 13-26 with a 170-member Indian contingent (5 outlets). Kuwait's army concluded its Kazma-12 logistics exercise.
topics.T12: Microsoft said Teams, Outlook and other services fully recovered after a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments for over 24 hours (3 outlets). Separately, a nationwide US air traffic ground halt, since cleared by the FAA, affected flights including three India-bound ones (4 outlets). The stories cite no cause for either disruption and do not attribute them to a cyber attack.
topics.T13: Coverage is mostly opinion and politically framed, with little hard news. The one concrete item is UK approval of an asylum center for 1,256 men near Piddington (2 outlets). Other single-outlet pieces cover a US congressman-elect backing a halt to immigration, a UK Senedd member barred from speaking, and a claim about falling US rents.
topics.T16: Items are mixed and single-sourced. Reports of Democratic gains in the US midterms include commentary on a National Popular Vote workaround to the Electoral College, and a report that JD Vance is weighing skipping 2028. South Sudan postponed its first national elections to February 11. Other items cover Rahul Gandhi's comments on India's democracy, Lula's digital campaign and an Ondo APC dispute.

bluf: A Myanmar military airstrike on a camp for people displaced by the civil war killed 12 people in Rakhine state, according to witnesses and a rescue worker (3 outlets). President Zelenskyy says the US has floated NATO membership for Ukraine, the first time the question has been linked to territorial concessions (14 outlets). A Trump-Xi-Putin meeting at APEC is being negotiated, with a nuclear treaty and the US war on Iran among priority topics, though the meeting is not confirmed (9 outlets). DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reportedly killed 5,471 of 11,197 confirmed cases, described as the deadliest in its history, with attacks on medics and no approved vaccine complicating the response (2 outlets). France saw its fifth consecutive Saturday of anti-government protests, with about 106,000 people nationwide and police using tear gas (3 outlets). On Iran, Trump is reportedly weighing holding off on new strikes unless Tehran or the Houthis provoke the US, amid mixed public signals about ending the war (2 outlets). Two outlets also report the administration floating a new military front in Cuba, where a fuel blockade is already in place.
